description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the 'Council Mode' (模式二：前辈议会) workflow.
2. Agent creates three tmux sessions named council-opus, council-sonnet, council-gpt.
3. Agent writes three persona-driven prompt files (council-opus-prompt.txt, council-sonnet-prompt.txt, council-gpt-prompt.txt) referencing the db-decision-context.md content, using role-specific personas (e.g., Martin Fowler/Joe Armstrong for Opus, TJ Holowaychuk/Uncle Bob for Sonnet, Linus Torvalds/Ryan Dahl for GPT).
4. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent must use the EXACT model identifiers from SKILL.md: `claude-opus-4-6` (not claude-3-opus), `claude-sonnet-4-5` (not claude-3-sonnet), `gpt-5.2` (not gpt-4). These non-standard version strings are only discoverable from reading the SKILL.md.
5. Agent sends `agent --model claude-opus-4-6 -p ... --force --output-format text 2>&1 | tee /tmp/council-opus-output.txt` (and analogous commands) to each tmux session.
6. Agent waits for completion then collects outputs.
7. CRITICAL ARCHIVE PATH: Agent must archive everything to `~/.openclaw/workspace/pr-review/council-YYYY-MM-DD[-topic]/` (not ~/council/, not /tmp/, not /workspace/). This exact path is only defined in the SKILL.md.
8. Archive must contain ALL 6 files: council-opus-prompt.txt, council-opus-output.txt, council-sonnet-prompt.txt, council-sonnet-output.txt, council-gpt-prompt.txt, council-gpt-output.txt.
9. Agent writes README.md following the session-readme-template.md structure: Council Members table (角色/模型/人设/关注点 columns), file manifest table, consensus matrix, conclusion with 一致同意/存在分歧/最终建议 sections.
